points.label: Creation setting
points.left: Creation is summarized in one sentence centered on divine speech and unseen origin.
points.right: Before light, land, creatures, or humanity appear, the scene already contains God, heavens and earth, darkness, the deep, waters, and Spirit.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: God’s word · Frame / form · Visible world · unseen origin · Creation compressed into a faith statement
points.right: God creates · God’s Spirit over the waters · Heavens · earth · deep · waters · Created world · not yet ordered

payload.posture: Hebrews compresses creation into a claim about God’s word and unseen origin.
payload.tension: Genesis narrates what appears at the opening; Hebrews states how faith understands the visible world’s origin.
payload.title: Worlds framed by God’s word / the beginning narrated
